utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the ninth. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, got you. Bit tinny, but that might be this headset.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. There's a birthday cake in the office, by the way. Before anyone mistakes it for their breakfast.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's a very narrow view of what counts as breakfast.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Especially with the broken coffee machine in the canteen. Cake and cold water, lovely start.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: The full Monday experience.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Indeed. Right, finished bits first, so we don't put them back on the list.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, so, finished the repair on the IM1 last night.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's closed, then? Not something you're carrying into this morning?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Closed. Just reporting it, not another job.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the Water Booster Pump yesterday. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Ah, right. I'd seen the old entry, wondered why that was still hanging about.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, old news. Definitely not another filter change on that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Just an observation from me: saw the pressure on the turbine one compressor dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, came back without anyone touching anything?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, on its own. Only flagging what I saw, not putting a job up for it.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the dryer—still can't get to the dryer until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Blocked, then. We're not allocating work on that in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Exactly. Nothing I can get into at the minute.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha Begum, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the fire panel by Wednesday? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the fire panel by Wednesday. First priority, understood.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just—sorry, talking over you. That's the permit and isolation bit, not the lock-out tag-out sign-off as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, keeping those as separate entries. Don't want the sign-off disappearing inside the permit wording.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire alarm panel? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire alarm panel. Understood, it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Fine, that keeps my bit clear. Permit to work and isolation, rather than claiming the whole lot.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep. Clear enough for me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: While we're on fire alarms, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test on the 3rd. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: So that entry is Sarah Okafor, monthly fire alarm test, on the 3rd?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. Separate from those panel jobs, and not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Good, because I heard 'test' and thought we'd suddenly changed what the isolation was for.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, no change. Just three separate lines rather than one enormous fire-alarm sentence.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, I'll inspect the boiler feed pump for leaks this afternoon. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: An inspection for leaks, yeah? Not a repair being bundled into that?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, inspect the boiler feed pump for leaks. That's the scope I'm taking, this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Priya Raman has that inspection. Urgent, this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: The other one needing doing is clear the jam and check the sensors on the wrapper, next Tuesday. Not an emergency but don't let it slip. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: I can't take the wrapper one. Don't put my name against it just because sensors got mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No, I can't own that either, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, nobody taking it. Still needs the jam cleared and the sensors checked on the wrapper next Tuesday. Not an emergency but don't let it slip; it's unallocated.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, leave the owner blank rather than making it look covered.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. It isn't covered by anyone here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll swap the filter on the compressor one first thing tomorrow. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: That's separate from the Water Booster Pump filter I mentioned, just so those don't get muddled.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, compressor one. Different job; your completed one stays completed.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Got it. Sarah for the filter on the compressor one, first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, mine. Not an emergency, but I don't want it slipping.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: What about the training records for the new starters? That's still on the list, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the training records for the new starters on Friday. That's a 'whenever you get a chance' one, so low priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sarah against the training records, on Friday. Not in the urgent pile.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. I'll do that one; it doesn't need the same fuss as the panel work.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Friday is the records, then. I briefly heard Friday and thought you'd moved my permit date.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, yours stays by Wednesday and needs doing first. Friday was just the records.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: This is why the coffee machine being broken is a serious conversational disadvantage.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: You've blamed that for three things already and we're barely started.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And none of them are a coffee-machine job on this list. Right, quick check we've all heard the same thing?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah. I've got the permit to work and isolation for the fire panel by Wednesday, first priority because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And I've accepted the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the fire alarm panel. Urgent, separate from that permit entry.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Boiler feed pump inspection for leaks is mine this afternoon. Urgent. All clear.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the IM1 repair stays closed. Nothing new from me.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Same here. Water Booster Pump filter done; dryer still blocked on that production window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. The wrapper is the gap: next Tuesday, no owner agreed. Not an emergency but don't let it slip—that remains the priority, not a claim that someone's taken it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's us. Thanks, everyone. And yes, cake does apparently count as breakfast.
